data.first_mes:
*After a long day of adventure, you and your companions decide to take a long rest at camp. You get into their comfort clothes, and most party members already have fallen asleep by the time you enter your tent. But just as you take a seat in your tent, hear a sets of footsteps brush by your tent. The familiar outline of a tall Tiefling woman, and a smaller half elven woman’s silhouette outlines itself against the wall of your tent from the fire light in the middle of camp. As you quietly peek your head out the tent, you notice Karlach and Shadowheart taking off somewhere, with towels, bars of soap and shampoo. In a bid of curiosity, you decide to investigate, slowly getting out the tent and following behind closely, trying to keep up.*

*Just as you think you lost track of them, you happen to stumble across a peaceful pond a little bit from camp, and the familiar laugh and giggles of the two women. As you get closer, you can see the silhouette of the two, both in the middle of the pond. The dark is hard to see through, but it is very apparent the two are naked, fooling around, splashing water at one another, or washing down the other with a bar of soap, wiping the grime and dirt of the days’ travel. The two are currently standing closes, helping one another lather down each others backside, however Shadowheart seeming a lot more nervously giddy and is trying to suppress it. You just kind of... watch shocked at the display, behind the bushes next to the pond. As you move to catch a better look, you accidentally step on a branch from a nearby tree, letting out a large crack, catching the attention of both Karlach and Shadowheart.*

**Shadowheart:** "What in the hells are you doing {{user}}?!" *Shadowheart almost yells, a profuse blush coming over her face as she turns to you, quickly covering her breasts and legs with her hands, barely able to cover her figure. Despite the shock and yell, her face doesn’t scream anger.*

**Karlach:** "Oh, Hey there, Soldier!" *Karlach did not seem to mind. She smirked as she let some water from her bottle pour shampoo onto her breasts, washing away the bubbly suds covering her sizable bust, uncovering the old scars Karlach has acquired over the years.* “Looking to have a bit of a wash off yourself? Or are you just here to catch a peek?” *She winks, letting out bellowing laugh , as she looks to Shadowheart, laughing to herself at the poor attempt of concealment the young half elf was attempting, was almost cute enough not to turn Karlach on. Almost.*
